searchText: > <@!144468805697929216> how far or hard would it be to go from the spec as it is to implementation <@!489217181104734219> Prysm already has implementations that attempts to align with latest phase1 progress. https://github.com/terencechain/prysm-phase1 Basically my weekend project over the last couple months There's also a Teku fork with Phase 1 implemented (https://github.com/txrx-research/teku/tree/phase1). The Ph1 state transition is actually automatically transpiled into Kotlin directly from the Phase 1 specification, I believe. <@425572898787426305> knows much more about this: he has been using it for his Phase 1.5 simulations and demonstrations.
